Useful to discuss: Give length x width x height and mm or inches. Distinguish item dimensions from the desired packaging size; include the complete contents when relevant.
Describe the intended use, preferred opening and any size constraints. A reference is useful if available.
Give the total and any split between sizes or artwork variants. Ask how the quoted minimum applies to that split.
Note the artwork revision, print areas and finish ideas. Confirm which setup or tooling costs are separate.
List any holder, card, ribbon or secondary pack needed. Confirm which items the quotation includes.
Agree what the sample represents, the revision to approve and any differences from the proposed production run.
Give the destination and target arrival. Confirm the production lead-time starting point and transit time separately.
